items.title: Marine fragility turned into opportunity
items.description: In March 2020, Seychelles accomplished what many larger nations have still not managed: We placed 30 percent of our national waters under formal legal protection, an expanse of ocean larger than Germany. We did this not because we could afford it, but because we couldn't afford not to.

items.description: The 2026 World Internet Conference Wuzhen Summit will take place from Nov 2 to 5 in Wuzhen, East China's Zhejiang province. The summit will gather executives from leading technology companies and developers of open-source large models to discuss how to build a global open-source AI ecosystem. Watch the video to find out!
